name: Sanctuary Cap Cana, Adult All-Inclusive Resort
insider_take: This secluded adults-only paradise sits within the exclusive Cap Cana marina community, where mega-yachts dock alongside world-class golf courses designed by Jack Nicklaus.
whats_special: Sanctuary Cap Cana is the only all-inclusive resort within the ultra-luxury Cap Cana development, offering exclusive access to the prestigious Punta Espada Golf Course - ranked #1 in the Caribbean. The property features a unique castle-like architecture inspired by Mediterranean design, with just 176 suites ensuring an intimate, uncrowded experience.
pro_tip: Book a suite with marina views to watch superyachts come and go, and request tee times at Punta Espada early in your stay - this Jack Nicklaus masterpiece often sells out to non-resort guests.
dont_miss: The resort's signature molecular gastronomy restaurant Lucia, the adults-only infinity pools with swim-up bars, and a sunset sail from the Cap Cana Marina. Take advantage of the complimentary access to the exclusive Juanillo Beach Club, consistently ranked among the world's best beaches.
pros: Luxury all-inclusive experience with premium amenities
Sophisticated adult-only environment for peaceful relaxation
Premium Cap Cana location with pristine beaches
Marriott STARS Program exclusive benefits and recognition
cons: This property is not available for online booking.
